commands: OUT="$(TMPDIR=_tempdir_ mktemp -t pyinfra.XXXXXX)" &&  MODE="$(stat -c %a /home/someone/something 2>/dev/null || stat -f %Lp /home/someone/something 2>/dev/null)" && OWNER="$(stat -c "%u:%g" /home/someone/something 2>/dev/null || stat -f "%u:%g" /home/someone/something 2>/dev/null || echo $(id -un):$(id -gn))" && awk '/# BEGIN PYINFRA BLOCK/ {n1++; if (f != 0 || n1 > 1) bad=1; f=1; next} /# END PYINFRA BLOCK/ {n2++; if (f != 1 || n2 > 1) bad=1; f=0; next} f == 0 {print} END {if (bad || f != 0 || n1 != 1 || n2 != 1) {print "pyinfra: invalid block markers in " FILENAME ", not modifying the file" > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1}}' /home/someone/something > $OUT  && mv "$OUT" /home/someone/something  && chown "$OWNER" /home/someone/something  && chmod "$MODE" /home/someone/something
